Rate limiter adds delay between requests to the same domain

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 1 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
puts result.rate_limit.min_duration_ms.inspect
```
